def append_segment(rows, start, end, step=.009, dwell=0):
    start=np.array(start,float); end=np.array(end,float)
    dist=np.linalg.norm(end[:3]-start[:3])
    n=max(1,int(math.ceil(dist/step)))
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        t=i/n; rows.append(start+(end-start)*t)
    for _ in range(dwell): rows.append(end.copy())
    return end

def run_to(points, dwell_last=0, note=''):
    global qpose
    rows=[]; cur=qpose.copy()
    for p,dw in points:
        cur=append_segment(rows,cur,np.array(p,float),dwell=dw)
    arr=np.array(rows,float)
